name: Roath Park Play Area
description: Cardiff Council play area at Roath Park, Cyncoed, Cardiff, one of the 116 on the council's 2020 list. Outdoor Cardiff says the playground and an adventure playground are in the Botanic Garden area, next to public toilets with baby changing.
